rules.prepare:
export PKG_CONFIG="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
# The usign path is a compile-time constant (deliberately not probed by # configure, since aept is cross-built). Point it at the prefix this # build installs into, so the tools build finds /tools/bin/usign. sed -i "s|^#define AEPT_USIGN_BIN .*|#define AEPT_USIGN_BIN \"$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/usign\"|" \ include/aept/internal.h
mkdir -p m4 autoreconf -vfi bh_autotools_dev_update
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --sysconfdir=/etc \ --localstatedir=/var \ --build="$AELTRA_BUILD_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-silent-rules
